structural.description: Verify the trace as a self-consistent artifact without dereferencing private policy/fact sources.

replay.description: Structural verification plus deterministic replay against the referenced policy set and selector facts.

sealed.description: Replay verification plus tamper-evident event-chain verification.

rules.assert: document validates against /policy-resolution-trace.schema.json
events[i].seq == i for every event
every event_id is unique
every cause_event_id exists and references an event with lower seq
all internal event references resolve exactly once
RFC8785-JCS SHA-256 of resolved policy-set input equals policy_set.digest
each referenced policy revision hashes to its declared digest
canonical selector facts hash to selector_facts_digest
re-evaluating each selector reproduces clause outcomes, matched flag, fallback eligibility/suppression, specificity class and ordering
every matched tag clause in a replayable trace has fact provenance or is covered by the selector-facts digest; tag provenance never supplies grant authority
topological expansion reproduces every inheritance_step; cycles yield rejected_policy_set
every operation from every matched/effective inherited policy emits exactly one operation_evaluated event
given before + operand + policy algebra, recomputation yields recorded outcome and after
every grant_decision has exactly one grant_evaluated; accepted grants require authority_source=user_explicit, authorization_ref, unexpired authority, valid scope, and no blocking lock/explicit deny
every explicit/default/conflict/reapplied/condition/expired/missing deny that affects state has one deny_applied event
every lock acquisition, inheritance, reapply, or blocked write that affects state has a lock_applied event
replaying operations through each stage reproduces gate_decisions and state_digest
exactly one gate_final exists for read, remember, acknowledge, answer, draft, act, escalate
each gate_final decision/scope/provenance agrees with replayed final effective policy and gate_results
exactly one resolution_final exists and result.final_event_id references it
canonical final effective policy hashes to result.effective_policy_digest and resolution_final.effective_policy_digest
privacy.raw_payload_embedded == false and no event payload embeds source message/body content
privacy.secret_values_embedded == false; sensitive values use ref/digest/redacted trace_value forms
canonicalization == RFC8785-JCS and algorithm == SHA-256
event_hash equals SHA-256(JCS(event excluding event_hash)) and prev_event_hash equals preceding event_hash; first prev_event_hash is null
hash_chain.chain_head equals final event_hash and resolution_final.chain_head

result_algorithm.INDETERMINATE: no ERROR check fails, but one or more required checks cannot execute because required external private material is unavailable
result_algorithm.PASS: all required checks for requested profile execute and pass
result_algorithm.WARN: warnings never upgrade FAIL/INDETERMINATE to PASS
